description: Configurable actionbar with .json storage, GUI editor, templates, custom colors, text styles and PNG images (heads) for Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge

mods.name: Actionbar Maker
mods.description: Configurable actionbar maker with json storage, GUI editor, templates, custom colors, text styles and PNG images (heads).

releases.notes:
ADDED:
- Actionbar groups. Now you can make group of actionbars, set pause before, after and other settings to play the whole set in one command
- New command: /abm stop @ a - stops playing actionbar
- Actionbar history (default on H). Now you can see last 20 actionbars played
- New button in actionbar gui - actionbars / groups selector. Change to see solo actionbars and their groups

CHANGED:
- Slightly edited actionbar interfaces
